verdicts.reason: A has a clear left-to-right banner structure. The headline is dominant on the left and the CTA is prominent with the body copy grouped above it. Its flaws: the product can is shrunk to a tiny icon, the tilted SUNSET SALE tag is wedged between the pills, background bubbles sit on the headline text, and the 'missing asset' placeholder is visible. B gets the hierarchy wrong. The legal fine print sits at the top left and is as large as the body copy, while the CTA has shrunk to a small pill off to the right. A bubble overlaps the logo wordmark so it reads 'SOLST CE', the SUNSET SALE tag is cut off at the right edge, the pills are scattered along the bottom, and the missing-asset placeholder is still visible.
